artGeneration: Built-in image generation from installed Xianbei Raider portrait. Original mounted-archer campaign ink illustration on white, multiply composited onto the approved Art of War parchment.

paragraphs: Xianbei Raiders are Wei's unique mounted archers, bringing the mobility of horsemen to the battlefield.
They evoke the northern tribes whose mounted warriors feature in Wei's campaign story, alongside the armies that fought for control of China.
Their distinctive charged attack releases a volley of arrows, then recharges before another burst is ready.
They can threaten infantry from a distance, while skirmishers and camel riders pose a danger. Mobility is a strength, but these battles test them in the same fixed arena as their opponents.

descriptionParagraphs: Xianbei Raider versus the approved unique-unit roster, one recorded battle per matchup.
Equal resource cost, up to 27 main units per side, with whole-unit rounding. Xianbei Raider is always Player 2; Player 1 inherits the opposing civilization.
The Golden ranged-versus-melee screen is retained unchanged, outside the main-army resource budget. Ranged-versus-ranged has no screen.
The intro and compilation are drafts pending review. Chapter outcomes and HP totals will be populated from verified captures. Five-seed V3 simulation comparisons are reported separately.
